def count_ones_in_range(n, l, r):
    def generate_sequence(n):
        sequence = []
        while n > 0:
            sequence.append(n % 2)
            n //= 2
        return sequence[::-1]

    def transform_sequence(sequence):
        i = 0
        while i < len(sequence):
            if sequence[i] > 1:
                x = sequence[i]
                sequence[i] = x // 2
                sequence.insert(i + 1, x % 2)
                sequence.insert(i + 2, x // 2)
                i += 2
            else:
                i += 1
        return sequence

    # Generate the initial sequence
    sequence = generate_sequence(n)
    
    # Transform the sequence until all elements are 0 or 1
    while any(x > 1 for x in sequence):
        sequence = transform_sequence(sequence)
    
    # Count the number of 1s in the range l to r (1-indexed)
    count_of_ones = sum(sequence[l-1:r])
